    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Address
    One value that names any addressable thing (a vanilla slot, a created slot, a panel element or a panel itself), so the engine can resolve every behavior by address without asking what kind it is.
    BehaviorKey<V>
    Names one behavior the window can resolve: gating, visibility, a panel's opacity, a reaction and so on.
    BehaviorKeys
    The library's built-in BehaviorKeys, one constant per behavior.
    CategoryPanels
    One panel on every group of a category that shows on the open menu, vanilla or created, on-demand instances included.
    CategoryPanels.On
    Where one of a category's panels goes, and which group it is on.
    ClientMenu
    The client half of a CustomMenu: its screen class, how each of its panels looks, and the request to open it.
    ClientSlots
    What the client can ask about a slot group while a screen is open.
    CreatedSlot
    A slot that is a vanilla Slot to everything outside it.
    CreatedSlotGroup
    A group of slots: their Storage, shift-click priority, right-click handler and layout.
    CreatedSlots
    Adds real, server-synced, persistent slots to a vanilla menu.
    CreatedSlots.Builder
    Configures one group of slots.
    CreatedSlots.RegisteredSlots
    What register() created: the MenuPanel and CreatedSlotGroup, plus the slot-index range appended to the menu, for consumers that walk the slots directly.
    CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>
    Implemented by consumers to extend storage attachments.
    CustomContainerMenu
    A custom container menu: its created slots, its panels as the server knows them, and whether each is shown.
    CustomContainerScreen
    Client-side partner to CustomContainerMenu: a standalone screen whose panels hold slot groups.
    CustomContainerScreen.DragMode
    A custom drag behavior for created slots.
    CustomContainerScreen.KeyAction
    Action triggered by a key press while this screen is open.
    CustomContainerScreen.ScreenEventListener
    Listener for events inside this screen.
    CustomMenu
    A complete custom menu from one define(...).register() chain.
    CustomMenu.Builder
    Configures the menu.
    CustomMenu.HandlerFactory
    Builds the menu's CustomContainerMenu.
    Decl<V>
    A behavior declaration at one specificity level (per slot, per group and so on): Decl.Set: this level declares a value, and the cascade stops here and uses it, an explicit off such as Set(TriBool.FALSE) included. Decl.Inherit: this level defers, and the cascade falls through to the next level down.
    Decl.Inherit<V>
    Explicit deferral; the cascade falls through to the next level.
    Decl.Set<V>
    An explicit declared value; the cascade stops here.
    DropRule
    What happens to a player-scoped slot's content on death, set per attachment.
    EphemeralStorage
    In-memory storage that is never saved.
    GatingContext
    The context a SlotGate decision runs in: who is acting, and on which slot.
    GroupKey
    A bulk-addressing group: a stable id plus a membership predicate over Addresses.
    ItemPath
    Where one item is, as both sides can name it: a top-level slot in the inventory, the ender chest, a supplied container (ItemRef.Source.CONTAINER, such as an open chest) or a carried attachment (ItemRef.Source.CARRIED, named by its id), then the index inside each container on the way down.
    ItemRef
    One item found by ItemSources, wherever it sits: a top-level slot, or inside a shulker box or bundle, any number of containers deep.
    ItemRef.Source
    Where a top-level slot is: the player's inventory, their ender chest, a Container the caller supplies (an open chest or barrel), which the Container overloads of ItemSources walk and resolve, or a player attachment declared carried() (ItemPath.attachment() says which; since 2.2.0, met only under ItemScope.carried).
    ItemScope
    Where ItemSources looks: the player's 36 main slots always, and optionally their carried attachments, the ender chest, the inside of shulker boxes and the inside of bundles, nested up to a depth limit.
    ItemSources
    Every item a player has, including the ones inside shulker boxes and bundles, to any depth: one walk, with every write going back up the chain of containers to the top-level slot.
    ItemSources.Found
    One item ItemSources.find(Player, ItemScope, Predicate) saw: where it is, and a copy of it (path().depth() is how deep).
    ItemState<T>
    A value that rides on an item: "open", "favorite", a mark.
    ItemState.Saved
    Whether the state is saved with the item.
    ItemVisitor
    Called by ItemSources.walk(ServerPlayer, ItemScope, ItemVisitor) for each item, nearest first.
    KeyedStorage
    A Storage that knows its own persistent identity.
    KeyedStorages
    Factories for KeyedStorage, a Storage that declares its own PersistentContainerKey so per-slot state persists for registered slots.
    KindTag
    What kind of addressable thing an Address names.
    LiveItem
    One item at an ItemPath, held for as long as a menu stays open on it: a shulker box in a chest, or a bundle in a shulker in a chest.
    MendingCandidates
    Lets a consumer add extra items to the XP repair pool, beyond the slots opted in through BehaviorKeys.MENDING.
    MendingCandidates.Candidate
    One mendable item plus how to persist its repair.
    MendingCandidates.Provider
    Supplies a player's extra mend candidates when an XP orb is collected.
    MenuPanel
    A panel as a menu knows it on both sides: its id and whether its slots are shown.
    MenuScreenFactory
    Builds the client CustomContainerScreen for a registered CustomMenu.
    MenuSwitch
    Switching a player between menus while one menu, the one they opened in the world, waits open behind the others.
    MenuSwitch.Reason
    Why the set-aside menu closed.
    MenuSwitch.SetAsideClosed
    Hears the set-aside menu close on its own.
    OnDemandGroup
    A slot group a menu gets on demand: declared once at init, like a ParityGroup, but on no menu until the server adds an instance of it to the menu the player has open, and gone again when the server removes it or the menu closes.
    OnDemandGroup.Instance
    One instance of a kind, on one menu.
    OperationProbe
    Lets a test mod check the click-tag hand-off and the in-world actions: which operation a sent click carried, and whether an action would be refused.
    OperationProbe.Tag
    A click tag as the probe sees it: the operation pair it carries.
    ParityGroup
    A slot group with container parity: real, synced slots on every screen that shows the player inventory (survival, creative, and every chest, furnace or modded container), registered in one call with no mixin.
    PersistentContainerKey
    Persistent identity for a Container, the owner a slot's state attaches to, in a form that survives session boundaries.
    PersistentContainerKey.BlockEntityKey
    Block-entity-backed container (chest, shulker box, furnace, hopper, etc.).
    PersistentContainerKey.EnderChest
    The player's ender chest (distinct from their main inventory).
    PersistentContainerKey.EntityKey
    Entity-backed container (donkey, llama, mule, minecart-with-chest, etc.).
    PersistentContainerKey.Modded
    Modded container type.
    PersistentContainerKey.PlayerInventory
    The player's main inventory, hotbar, armor, and offhand slots.
    PlayerStorage
    Marks a Storage as the player inventory side of a menu, as opposed to the container side.
    Presence
    What the other side runs, as the handshake found it when the player joined.
    QuickMoveRoutes
    Where a shift-click goes, on any menu, when a mod knows better than the menu.
    QuickMoveRoutes.Dest
    One destination in a route.
    QuickMoveRoutes.Dest.Group
     
    QuickMoveRoutes.Dest.GroupOf
     
    QuickMoveRoutes.Dest.ToPlayer
     
    QuickMoveRoutes.Dest.ToVanilla
     
    QuickMoveRoutes.Route
    Answers where a shift-click from source goes, or null for no opinion.
    ReactCause
    Why a reaction fired.
    ReactEvent
    What a ReactiveHook receives when a slot's contents change.
    ReactiveHook
    A consumer's reaction to a slot's synced contents changing on the client, the value type of the ON_INSERT_OBSERVED/ON_TAKE_OBSERVED behavior keys.
    ResolvedSlotGroup
    One slot group as it exists on an open menu: what it is called, what kind of thing it is, and which slots it currently holds.
    SlotDoubleClick
    A plain left double-click on a slot, taken for a mod's own action (open the item, say).
    SlotDoubleClick.Kind
     
    SlotDoubleClick.Pair
    A double-click taken: the slot (the real one), its index on the menu the server has open, and the stack.
    SlotDoubleClick.Pending
    A registration's pending pairs, on the client thread.
    SlotDoubleClick.Starts
    Whether a first click on slot's stack, with the cursor empty, may start a pair.
    SlotElement
    A registered slot shown as a PanelElement.
    SlotElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotElement.
    SlotFlowElement
    Lays out a panel's registered slots to fit its width, the way text and elements size to fit.
    SlotFlowElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotFlowElement over slot elements, in flow order.
    SlotGate
    What a slot accepts and releases, and how much of an item it holds: the value of BehaviorKeys.GATING, the slot author's rule.
    SlotGroupCategories
    The registry of SlotGroupResolvers, one primary per menu class.
    SlotGroupCategory
     
    SlotGroupElement
    One slot group as one element, found by its id on whatever menu is open, and shown in rows.
    SlotGroupElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotGroupElement.
    SlotGroupId
    Names one slot group, one coherent run of slots sitting in one place on screen.
    SlotGroupId.Category
    The one group a resolver contributes for category on a menu: vanilla's resolvers, and a mod's own resolver for its own menu, name a group this way.
    SlotGroupId.Created
    A group created through SlotKit, named by its declaration.
    SlotGroupPanelAdapter
    Anchors a Panel to slot groups and slots on container screens: a toolbar above the player inventory, a readout beside the hotbar, a slot above the offhand.
    SlotGroupResolver
    Maps one menu class's instances to slot groups by SlotGroupCategory, as slot indices (positions in menu.slots).
    SlotGroups
    Every slot group anyone has declared, with no menu open: the menu-free half of the slot group registry.
    SlotGroups.Entry
    One row of the player-facing list.
    SlotGroupSet
    A player-facing name for several slot groups that are one thing to the player.
    SlotHandle
    A typed handle on a slot, vanilla or created: the slot verbs, plus the generic WindowHandle.set(BehaviorKey, Decl).
    SlotLayout
    The slot layout of a CustomContainerMenu: which panels it has, which slot groups each holds, and how shift-click pairs them.
    SlotLayout.PanelBuilder
    One panel's slot groups and its server-side flags.
    SlotLayout.PanelSlots
    One declared panel, as built: its id, whether it starts shown, whether a player may toggle it, and its slot groups in order.
    SlotLooks
    How a slot draws an item while something holds for it: an animation, another model, or a mark under or over it.
    SlotLooks.When
    Whether a look applies to slot's stack this frame.
    SlotNames
    Display names for slots, on the client: labels like "Hotbar 3", "Chestplate" or "Offhand".
    SlotOperations
    The slot operations vocabulary: the open set of things that can be done to a slot, what each slot lets through, and the one question every operation asks before it acts.
    SlotOperations.AppliesTo
    Which slot groups an operation can act on.
    SlotOperations.GroupVeto
    A SlotOperations.Veto that is handed the slot's group: SlotGroups.of(SlotRef) of the slot, resolved once per question and shared by every group veto, or null when the slot is in no known group.
    SlotOperations.Role
    What an operation does to the slot it acts on.
    SlotOperations.Veto
    A rule that refuses an operation on a slot, laid over the cascade by a mod that is not the slot's author.
    SlotPlacement
    MenuKit Placements against slots, for a panel's in(ModeScope, Placement) (since 2.1.0).
    SlotRef
    The slot an operation is about to act on, as much of it as the seam can supply.
    SlotScreenRect
    A vanilla slot's on-screen item box in absolute screen-space pixels, what VanillaSlotResolver.resolve(AbstractContainerScreen, int) returns.
    SlotSpec
    A side-neutral description of one group of registered slots that a ParityGroup adds to every container the player opens.
    SlotState
    Entry point for persistent per-slot state.
    SlotStateChannel<T>
    A typed per-slot state channel, the handle consumers use to read and write slot state.
    SlotStateChannel.CanWrite
    Who may write this channel from a client.
    SlotStateChannel.Visibility
    Channel visibility.
    Storage
    Where items live: get, set, size and markDirty.
    StorageAttachment<O,C>
    Where a slot group's contents are saved, by owner type.
    StorageAttachment.PlayerStorageAttachment<C>
    A StorageAttachment with death handling, returned only by the player-anchored factories (StorageAttachment.playerAttached(String, String, int) and StorageAttachment.customPlayerAttached(CustomAttachmentSpec)).
    StorageContainerAdapter
    Adapts a Storage to vanilla's Container interface.
    Tier
    Which authority tier a BehaviorKey belongs to.
    TriBool
    The value a Decl.Set carries for a boolean BehaviorKey, so "explicitly off" is a declared value, distinct from "unset" or "inherit".
    VanillaSlotResolver
    Finds where a player-inventory slot is on whatever screen is open.
    VirtualStorage
    Storage backed by a read function and a write function, so a consumer can bring any external data source into the Storage interface.
    Window
    The entry point to the window: where a consumer gets a typed handle to set or read behavior on anything addressable.
    WindowEngine
    The window's resolution engine: one store, one cascade, one method, WindowEngine.resolve(Address, BehaviorKey).
    WindowHandle
    The base of the window's typed handles: an immutable value that addresses one thing by its Address, never by a live reference.
    WindowSignals
    Which slot the cursor is over (WindowSignals.hovered) and which slot was last clicked (WindowSignals.selected), as Addresses, observed on the client.
    WindowView
    The window's view of one open menu, which mints typed WindowHandles.
